tools.name: onet_search_occupations
tools.description: Search O*NET occupations by keyword. Returns O*NET-SOC codes + titles (with bright-outlook flag). The entry point: get a soc_code here, then query skills/knowledge/technology/outlook.

keyword.description: Keyword or phrase, e.g. 'data scientist', 'registered nurse', 'cybersecurity analyst'.

tools.name: onet_get_related_occupations
tools.description: Occupations related to a given O*NET-SOC code (shared skills/knowledge/tasks). Use to map the full career ecosystem a degree program could serve.

soc_code.description: O*NET-SOC code, e.g. '15-2051.00' for Data Scientists. Use onet_search_occupations to find one.

tools.name: onet_get_skills
tools.description: Skills required for an occupation, ranked by importance (0-100). Maps to program learning outcomes for curriculum design.

soc_code.description: O*NET-SOC code, e.g. '15-2051.00' for Data Scientists. Use onet_search_occupations to find one.

tools.name: onet_get_knowledge
tools.description: Knowledge areas for an occupation, ranked by importance (0-100). Maps to academic disciplines (which department should house a program).

soc_code.description: O*NET-SOC code, e.g. '15-2051.00' for Data Scientists. Use onet_search_occupations to find one.

tools.name: onet_get_technology
tools.description: Technology, software, and tools used in an occupation, grouped by category, with hot-technology and in-demand flags. Informs the curriculum tech stack.

soc_code.description: O*NET-SOC code, e.g. '15-2051.00' for Data Scientists. Use onet_search_occupations to find one.

tools.name: onet_compare_skills
tools.description: Compare skill requirements of two occupations: shared skills, gaps the target needs more of, and existing strengths. Use to design upskilling/reskilling programs.

soc_code_from.description: O*NET-SOC code of the current/starting occupation.

soc_code_to.description: O*NET-SOC code of the target occupation.

tools.name: onet_get_outlook
tools.description: Job outlook + career report for an occupation: projected growth category, bright-outlook status, salary percentiles (10th/median/90th), and description. Core program-viability data point.

soc_code.description: O*NET-SOC code, e.g. '15-2051.00' for Data Scientists. Use onet_search_occupations to find one.
